<style>
:root{
  --bg:#f7f8fa; --card:#ffffff; --ink:#1b2230; --muted:#667085; --line:#e3e7ee; --accent:#35569a; --soft:#e4eaf6; --chip:#f0f2f6;
  --a:#d6dff0; --b:#d9e7d9; --c:#efe3d0; --d:#e6dcef;
  --font:"Figtree",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Thai",sans-serif;
  color-scheme:light; box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#10141c;--card:#171c26;--ink:#e9edf4;--muted:#9aa4b5;--line:#262e3b;--accent:#8fb0f0;--soft:#1e2a44;--chip:#1f2632;--a:#25324d;--b:#25382b;--c:#3a3224;--d:#312a40;color-scheme:dark}
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#10141c;--card:#171c26;--ink:#e9edf4;--muted:#9aa4b5;--line:#262e3b;--accent:#8fb0f0;--soft:#1e2a44;--chip:#1f2632;--a:#25324d;--b:#25382b;--c:#3a3224;--d:#312a40;color-scheme:dark}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 64px)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:17px/1.6 var(--font);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg);z-index:10}
a{color:var(--accent)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
nav{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:11;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
nav div{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px;display:flex;gap:22px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
nav a{padding:18px 0;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;font-size:16px;white-space:nowrap}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
main{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px 56px}
section{padding:38px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
section:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.lbl{font:600 13px var(--font);letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px}
.hero{display:flex;gap:26px;align-items:center;padding-top:40px}
.avatar{flex:none;width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--soft);color:var(--accent);display:grid;place-items:center;font:800 34px var(--font);overflow:hidden}
.avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hi{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px}
h1{font:800 clamp(30px,5vw,40px)/1.15 var(--font);margin:2px 0 6px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.tag{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:18px}
.btns{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:22px}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:10px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:16px}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn.primary{color:#10141c}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .btn.primary{color:#10141c}}
.about p{margin:0 0 14px;max-width:70ch}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:26px}
.stat small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.stat b{font:800 32px/1.2 var(--font);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.tl{position:relative;margin:0;padding:0 0 0 28px;list-style:none;border-left:2px solid var(--line);margin-left:5px}
.tl li{position:relative;padding-bottom:26px}
.tl li:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.tl li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-36px;top:8px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--bg)}
.tl h3{font:600 19px/1.35 var(--font);margin:0}
.tl h3 span{font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}
.tl .d{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;margin:2px 0 6px}
.tl p{margin:0;max-width:66ch}
.grp{margin:0 0 22px}
.grp h3{font:500 17px var(--font);color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 10px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.chips li{background:var(--chip);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 16px;font-size:16px}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:20px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px}
.shot{height:140px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 18px var(--font);color:var(--ink);text-align:center;padding:10px;overflow:hidden}
.shot img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.card h3{font:700 19px/1.3 var(--font);margin:0 0 4px}
.card p{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px}
.res{display:inline-block;background:var(--chip);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 14px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.edu h3{font:700 20px/1.3 var(--font);margin:0}
.edu p{margin:2px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}
.contact{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.contact a,.contact span{display:inline-block;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

.card{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s,border-color .15s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--accent)}
.shot{padding:0;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/10;height:auto}
.hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;margin:14px 0 0}
dialog{border:0;border-radius:16px;padding:0;width:min(1000px,94vw);max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink)}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(10,14,24,.72)}
dialog .full{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
dialog .mb{padding:22px 26px 28px}
dialog .sub{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
dialog h3{font:800 26px/1.2 var(--font);margin:4px 0 10px}
dialog .mb p{max-width:70ch}
dialog .chips{margin-top:14px}
.x{position:sticky;top:10px;float:right;margin:10px 10px 0 0;z-index:2;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);font-size:24px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .hero{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
  .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>

  <p class="lbl">About</p>
  <p>I have 22 years in Thai advertising, from Account Executive to Chief Client Officer at Accenture Song Thailand. I build long-term client relationships, lead 360-degree and CRM programs, and win pitches, across consumer products, food and beverage, retail, financial services and corporate branding.</p>
  <p>I set targets, drive teams to reach them, and keep budgets, timelines and quality on track. I work in Thai and English.</p>

    <li><h3>Freelance Project Consultant</h3><div class="d">After Ogilvy, before Accenture Song</div><p>Led Nescafé MRT Wat Mangkon (2019) with Publicis and other high-profile projects for leading Thai brands.</p></li>
